title: RoyalBaby EZ-Shark 16 Inch Kids Bike, Mako Shark

comparisons.notes: New, in stock (page listed 14); exact match MPN RB16-53SH, 16-inch Mako Shark. Listed $391.99; advertised storewide code CLEARANCE for 20% off yields $313.59 before shipping or tax. Code was not tested at checkout.

writeup: Woot has the new RoyalBaby EZ-Shark 16-inch kids bike in Mako Shark for $74.99. The matching model is RB16-53SH, a beginner bike with 16-inch wheels. RetailKing lists that same bike new and in stock at $391.99, or $313.59 after its advertised storewide CLEARANCE code (the code was not tested at checkout). That puts Woot about 76% below, a savings of about $239. Six were left, with a limit of 10 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Verified price check identified exact ASIN B0DL55DTVC for the 16-inch Mako Shark / RB16-53SH. The Amazon page itself returned an error during the check.
